regex: Python re syntax, applied with search() to the full Bash command text
exclude: Optional per signature. Before match is applied, every non-overlapping occurrence of exclude in the command is replaced by one space (re.sub). A command is a hit when match then finds a search() hit.
context: Optional per signature. subagent means a call counts as a hit only when it comes from a subagent; the rate still divides by all Bash calls.
baseline: compound-cd and nested-agent-cli are the v2 patterns unchanged, so counts stay like for like with the 2026-10-08 guard-hook baseline

signatures.description: A command that starts with a directory change chained to another command by && or ;.
codex exec, review or consult launched in command position; counted only when the calling context is a subagent.
mora read or mora search run in command position without --json in the same simple command.

A command that names the memory tool's data folders (~/.local/share/mora or ~/vault/mora, also as $HOME, /home/<user>, /Users/<user> or /root forms) other than in a find exclusion (-not -path, ! -path, -path ... -prune) or an --exclude, --exclude-dir, --ignore or negated --glob flag.
